title: A shell waits, then opens a TCP connection
threat_model: An attacker's shell waits longer than the detection's window before it connects out.
known_gap: outbound_after_exec only counts a connect that comes within CONNECT_WINDOW_NS (60 s) of the latest exec of the process. A shell that sleeps longer than that before it connects is not seen.
notes: As S26, but the shell first runs sleep for SLEEP_SECONDS (70), set at the top of action.sh. A unit test checks it against the detection's window. The scenario is not run if the machine has no non-loopback IPv4 address.
